messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on customer wins/losses. Capturing the signals so GTM/Eng can act. TL;DR: wins = fast pilot migrations + clear cost examples; losses = KMS timelines, SLA clarity, and a few reliability edge-cases.

sam: Solid summary. From GTM: prioritize anything that unblocks contracts (KMS/SLA). We need a concise SLA menu for AEs.

lucy: Engineering note: a lightweight fallback model and a KV eviction dashboard would cut down support volume. Estimate a 3-week small-squad effort for a minimal canary.

ben: CS: I'll redact 4 closed-lost notes and add "what would have helped" bullets. Also drafting a 1-page migration checklist with rollback and test traffic examples.

tara: Product: will own the customer-facing one-pager and FAQ. Need legal to weigh in on SLA language. @sam can you loop legal?

sam: Yep, I'll take legal coordination for SLA packaging.

maria: Can owners confirm timelines: SLA menu (sam) by next Tue, one-pager (tara) by Fri, canary plan (lucy) in 3w? Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.

lucy: Confirming 3w for canary plan. Will share metrics we need for gating.

ben: I'll post the redacted lost-deal summaries and the migration checklist draft by EOD Thursday.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-2026: "All-hands follow-up: SLA menu + migration playbook + canary" assigned to sam,lucy,tara, linked to thread 2310012345.

maria: Great; created the action doc and calendar invite for a 20m sync next Wed 10am. If you want to add agenda items, reply here. :calendar:
